description: GTFS DiviaMobilités is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DiviaMobilités. Theoretical offer of the Bus and Tramway DiviaMobilities network in the GTFS format of Dijon metropolis. You will also find all the theoretical schedules of all our DiviaMobilities lines, the list of stops, the lines, as well as the layout of the lines. This dataset is updated with each modification of the transport offer. Coverage: DiviaMobilités. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS DiviaMobilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DiviaMobilités. Its keywords include deplacements, transports, tramay, bus, mobilites. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GTFS-RT, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
